sentences.japanese: もしスペンサーが文を足して訳し続けなければ、他の貢献者がきっと彼を追い抜くだろう。
sentences.english: If Spenser doesn't keep adding and translating sentences, the other contributors will surely surpass him.

sentences.japanese: 君は不屈の精神で危機を切り抜けられるだろう。
sentences.english: Your undaunted spirit will carry you through.

sentences.japanese: 君は犬が庭を通り抜けて行くのを見なかったかい。
sentences.english: Didn't you see a dog pass through the yard?

sentences.japanese: 空気が抜けるにつれて風船は徐々に降りてきた。
sentences.english: The balloon descended gradually as the air came out.

sentences.japanese: 狭い戸口を通り抜けようとする二人の肥った男が行き詰まっている。
sentences.english: Two fat men trying to pass through a narrow doorway are in checkmate.
